sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Gangetic plains spread
  • Trade route influence
  • International expansion

Personalities

  • Buddha (The Founder)
  • Ashoka (The Patron)
  • Nagarjuna (The Philosopher)

Contribution Overview

  • Language: Promotion of Pali and Prakrit leading to mass communication.
  • Art: Rock-cut architecture (Chaityas/Viharas) and Stupa culture (Sanchi/Bharhut).
  • Social: Egalitarian approach challenging the rigidity of the Varna system.
CategoryContribution
LiteratureTripitakas (Sutta, Vinaya, Abhidhamma)
